description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::poisson_distribution class, including interface compliance, serialization, statistical tests, and stability tests. It also includes internal implementation details and test utilities for the Poisson distribution.

classes.name: PoissonDistributionInterfaceTest
classes.description: Template class testing the interface and serialization of absl::poisson_distribution for various integer types.

classes.name: PoissonModel
classes.description: Class modeling the statistical properties of a Poisson distribution, including CDF initialization and inverse CDF computation.

classes.name: PoissonDistributionZTest
classes.description: Test fixture class implementing z-tests for the Poisson distribution with fixed parameters and internal RNG.

classes.name: PoissonDistributionChiSquaredTest
classes.description: Test fixture class implementing chi-squared goodness-of-fit tests for the Poisson distribution with fixed parameters and internal RNG.

methods.name: SerializeTest
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of the poisson_distribution object.

methods.name: InitCDF
methods.description: Initializes the CDF vector for the Poisson distribution based on the mean.

methods.name: InverseCDF
methods.description: Returns the inverse CDF (percent-point function) for a given probability.

methods.name: LogCDF
methods.description: Logs the CDF values for debugging.

methods.name: SingleZTest
methods.description: Performs a z-test on generated Poisson variates to verify distribution correctness.

methods.name: ChiSquaredTestImpl
methods.description: Performs a chi-squared goodness-of-fit test on generated data.

methods.name: InitChiSquaredTest
methods.description: Sets up cutoff points and expected counts for chi-squared testing.
